```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-demo
#| fig-cap: "Placeholder chart — random data, not heat-related deaths."

library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

font <- 'Roboto Condensed'

set.seed(42)
demoData <- tibble(
  year = 2000:2024,
  deaths = round(500 + cumsum(rnorm(25, mean = 15, sd = 40)))
)

demoData |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    aes(x = year, y = deaths),
    fill = "#980000FF",
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2024, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = 'Deaths',
    title = 'Demo chart',
    subtitle = 'Simulated data, here only to test that plots render',
    caption = 'Data source: none — randomly generated'
  ) +
  theme_minimal_hgrid(font_family = font) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "italic"),
    legend.position = 'none',
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white', color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = 'white', color = NA)
  )
```
